service_scope.value: Tear-off and re-roof of an existing home. Live /roof-replacement/ lists materials installed: architectural asphalt shingles, metal, slate, synthetic. Products: CertainTeed or GAF shingles (client: certified factory installers of both), corrosion-resistant flashings and synthetic underlayment (W11). On a replacement Apex pulls the Town permit and GAF System Plus warranties are mentioned (Paul 2026-10-09 from a review, Paul Exception to CM-027). Materials list as a whole not confirmed by the client.
service_scope.source: Live site https://apexroofingtlc.com/roof-replacement/ (public-sources capture 2026-10-05, H2/H3); Brand Guide D Products installed (W11); returned sheet Message 2; decisions-settled pilot_facts_2026_10_09 and synthetic_roofing

service_process.value: In the client's own words, what separates a good install: the underlayment and its thickness, sealed valleys, trim, handling wood rot, nail spacing, how methodical the install is, straightness of the shingles; enough flashing, not 'a tube of silicone'. Photos of the work with progress photos each day; daily clean-up and magnet sweep (Paul 2026-10-09).
